narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>In each place I take the smaller from the larger. That gives thirteen and three tenths and four hundredths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the top number has only four hundredths, and eight cannot come out of four.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The top number is always the one we take from, so we must break a place.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 8 − 4 = 4, 6 − 3 = 3, 15 − 2 = 13; 4 hundredths cannot cover 8; the slip is struck

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>When a place is short, break one from the place on its left.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Take two and five tenths and four hundredths from six and two tenths and three hundredths.
